name: Morciano di Romagna (Italy)
description: Maroon field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Morciano di Romagna (a caduceus on yellow above waves on blue) within branches, with the motto VETUS MORCEANI FORUM on a scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Morciano di Romagna, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Morciano di Romagna arms — caduceus on yellow above waves on blue, crowned, within branches, with motto VETUS MORCEANI FORUM
